name: Acquia CMS Headless UI
description: Implements Pure Headless mode, disabling the Drupal Front-End and updating the admin experience.
project_description: Submodule of Acquia CMS Headless. Implements Pure Headless mode: disables Drupal's front end (front page becomes a login screen, 403 redirects to login), restructures the admin toolbar and menus around the API (Access / Data model / System administration), rewrites canonical entity tabs to their JSON:API representation, and adds a Next.js site-preview tab on nodes. Enabled from the Headless tour step's 'Enable Headless mode' checkbox.
